Quick Demo (Requirements 1-6)
item.description:
Run this folder by itself, from 00 through 14, with the Campground Booking environment selected and freshly seeded local data (node seeder -i from backend). Do not run the other folders first.

00 logs in as user1@gmail.com / 123456. 01-02 demonstrate location filtering and date availability. 03-06 demonstrate profile and password changes. 07 shows campground details. 08 finds the seeded completed, unreviewed Erawan stay. 09 saves a rating; 10 adds the written review to that same rating. 11 shows the result. 12-14 remove the demo review and restore the original seeded profile and password so the demo can be repeated.

Variables and tokens are captured automatically with demo-prefixed names. Set demoDate in the environment to choose a date (YYYY-MM-DD); if absent, it defaults to 30 days from today.

During the demo, the account becomes user1.demo@example.com / DemoPass123. If interrupted after changing the profile or password, continue with the remaining requests, including cleanup, or reseed your disposable local database. Seeding clears existing data.
